title: Bitwise ORs of Subarrays (Set Propagation)

monster.name: Cumulative Hydra
monster.title: Expander of Monotonic OR Fronts
monster.defeatQuote: Number of distinct bitwise OR results from all continuous subarrays!

description: Given an integer array `arr`, return the number of distinct bitwise ORs of all the non-empty subarrays of `arr`.
hints: Since an integer has at most 30 bits, curr set has size at most 30 at each step.
